description: This file exports constants that define ID values, module functionalities, and a complex diagram rendering object using D3.js and other libraries for rendering ER diagrams, including configuration, entity, attribute, and relationship handling.

classes.name: R
classes.description: Parser class for handling the syntax of ER diagram input, including rule definitions and parsing logic.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Configure diagram parameters such as layout direction, margins, node spacing, and styles.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Render an ER diagram within a specified DOM element using D3.js, including entity, attribute, and relationship visualization.

methods.name: addEntity
methods.description: Add a new entity to the internal data structure.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Attach attributes to a specified entity.
